messages.text:
"Sidescroller - 16-bit graphic format - similar to Mario - but with a twist on the theme towards a slightly less colorful and \"delightful\" version - also, obviously, instead of Mario, another figure (similar, but noticeably not Mario in look) in Black/White colored clothing instead of the Blue/Red scheme - the levels very much similar in style as far as how they're laid out - power ups should provide a helpful (and temporary), but NOT NECESSARY advantage to passing a part of the game, UNLESS it is on a final level before a \"Boss Battle\" - also, when the player gets a power up, give the sprite color that matches the according power up that was picked up by the player (fire=red, water=blue, etc.)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
